stability_thresholds.psi_yellow: 0.10 to 0.25 (Moderate drift; increase monitoring frequency, review origination mix)
stability_thresholds.psi_red: >= 0.25 (Significant drift; trigger model re-estimation or pause automated cut-offs)

performance_triggers.auc_floor: Test AUC must remain >= 0.65; alert if rolling 3-month AUC drops by > 0.05
performance_triggers.calibration_error: Expected-to-Actual (E/A) default ratio by score decile must stay between 0.80 and 1.25

operational_alerts: Pipeline input missingness spikes (>5% above training baseline)
Approval rate deviations > 3% from policy benchmark
